title: Wildlife-RP
description: Resource pack for ArmyFury's WildLife plugin
body:
Assets for ArmyFury's WildLife plugin to make the experience feel more closer to the one in the series!

Keep in mind this will remodel and retexture ALL slimes and armour stands for now

## Requirements -

- [ETF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures) and [EMF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features) mods on client side or Optifine (untested)

  
## Features -

- Makes Trivia Bot look near identical to one in the series
- Makes snails look more like snails in the series (Work in progress)
